name: Mountain Me
addr: 114 W State St, Black Mountain, NC 28711
hours: Mon 11 AM–5 PM; Tue 11 AM–5 PM; Wed 11 AM–5 PM; Thu 11 AM–5 PM; Fri 10 AM–5 PM; Sat 10 AM–5 PM; Sun 11 AM–5 PM

reviews.t: Very nice store, very friendly and not rude about not wearing a mask, we bought some essential oils and had a great conversation with the owners. Highly recommend stopping by without your mask, it's OK!

My husband and I happened on this shop tooling around the city, during our anniversary vacation. The first thing that struck me was the heavenly smells from the different candles, soaps and small knick-knacks--I love that type of stuff! The shop was a nice mix of inspirational and Christian wares. We bought several items for family souvenirs and a couple for ourselves. The customer service was very attentive and the atmosphere, very welcoming. We definitely recommend a stop there if you are in that area--we will absolutely be back!

Amazing customer service and gifts! They sell a lot of items that have puns/jokes on it and those are my weakness so of course I bought so many. Each worker I've met is a Christian and they are very welcoming and inviting. I genuinely felt like a friend just walking in the door

The people that own this shop are AMAZING! The level of service is something I haven't seen in a while. From directing you to items you are looking for to gift wrapping, they do it all. And the shop items are changed frequently, so returning in different seasons will net you some great gifts, for yourself and others.

The shop is quaint, well put together and has a nice variety of items. The woman working this past Sunday helped my boyfriend sneakily buy me a bear that meant a lot to us both. Whomever you are, your time, care and attn is very appreciated and I wish you well. Thank you so much!

If you’re ever in Black Mountain, NC, stop in! By far the sweetest lady we met on our entire vacation to Asheville. The world is tough right now. It’s all about Covid, masks and vaccines (especially in Asheville). It’s made folks grouchy. She was a sweet, pleasant breath of fresh air. It’s such a cute little shop, I was honored to give her my business!!
This store had the most perfect gifts and beautiful staff. We will definitely be returning. Thank you.
Wonderful store with great gifts and lovely decor. To top it off, very kind & helpful folks run this little gem of a shop :)
A lovely store. Definitely take time to look at everything.
Very pretty gift items in this shop. Mostly things you could buy anywhere. Clean and well organized.
